new_defects.title: Home strip says '(server busy)' on an idle app, beside counts the server has just re-verified as exact
new_defects.repro: Unlock any corpus, leave the app idle for more than 90 s (no collection, no jobs, airplane mode), then open Home and read the at-a-glance strip, in any language.
new_defects.expected: No 'server busy' claim while nothing is running. The counts are exact (nothing was written), so at most an honest 'as of' with no busy claim.
new_defects.actual: The strip reads 'as of 09:07 AM (server busy)' (fr 'à 09:07 (serveur occupé)', ar 'حتى 09:07 ص (الخادم مشغول)') for as long as the app stays idle. At that moment /api/scheduler/activity running:false, /api/jobs is empty, and /api/database/stats returns cache_age_s 318 with ttl 30, cached true. The age grows without bound on an idle app, so the busy note becomes permanent on every idle install.
new_defects.evidence: extra.json strip.note, strip.api_age, scheduler, jobs; shots/extra-strip-server-busy-en-crop.png; w375_ar_fr.json ar.home/fr.home. The stats kept as_of 09:07:53 for more than 10 minutes while three polls 4 s apart showed cache_age_s 239/243/247 and articles 457 unchanged.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/api/served_cache.py:147-152 computes cache_age_s from built_at even when :234-244 has just re-verified the value ('Nothing was written … it is still exactly right', which re-stamps only checked_at). By design an idle app 'rebuilds nothing at all' (docstring :52-56). src/static/app-home.js:113-137 (_STALE_NOTE_S = 90) turns any age ≥ 90 s into t('as of {time} (server busy)'). The two modules disagree about what a large age means.

items.ref: new:Home strip says '(server busy)' on an idle app, beside counts the server has just re-verified as exact
items.evidence: My own encrypted STATE C seed in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/U-recheck/seeded. Booted on port 8980 with neither OO_DB_* variable set. lock-state read locked; I unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock and it then read unlocked-encrypted. I stayed on Home and touched nothing. I sampled /api/database/stats every 20 s (walk_a.json strip.samples). as_of stayed at 10:30:19 from t=44 s to t=144 s while cache_age_s rose 13→33→53→73→93→113, with cached true and ttl 30. Articles stayed at 453. At t=144 s the strip read 'as of 10:30 AM (server busy)'. After a live switch, fr read 'à 10:30 (serveur occupé)' and ar read 'حتى 10:30 ص (الخادم مشغول)'. At the same moment /api/scheduler/activity returned running:false and /api/jobs returned []. Shots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/U-recheck/shots/A1-strip-busy-en-crop.png, A1-strip-busy-fr-crop.png, A1-strip-busy-ar-crop.png. This is not by design. Brief S3.4(d) (docs/design/AUTONOMOUS_SESSION_BRIEF_2026-09-02_CRASH_ROOT_CAUSE.md:825) asks for the note on a STALE-SERVED payload. served_cache.py:236-244 says a value the probe verifies as unchanged 'is still exactly right'. The note therefore claims load exactly when there is none.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-home.js:117-120 (homeStatsAgeNote) shows the busy note whenever payload.cache_age_s >= 90. cache_age_s is time since BUILD (src/api/served_cache.py:152, _decorate). On an idle app, served_cache.cached() at :236-244 only re-stamps checked_at and deliberately never rebuilds, so built_at never moves and the age grows without bound. The payload carries no field that separates 'verified unchanged' from 'stale while a rebuild is pending', so the client reads every verified idle value as a busy server.
items.suggested_fix: In served_cache._decorate, also expose the verification state. Either add checked_age_s from entry['checked_at'], or add a 'stale' flag that is true only when the probe differs or a background refresh was kicked. In homeStatsAgeNote, show '(server busy)' only when that flag says the value is stale (or checked_age_s >= 90). When the value is verified unchanged, show nothing, or a neutral 'as of HH:MM' with no busy claim. Add a node or pytest check: an idle cache older than 90 s yields no busy note.

From a fresh ar render, a switch to en gives 'المجموعة: مشفّر (SQLCipher 4) 4.12.0 community / سجل العهدة: لم يُنشأ بعد', unchanged. items.root_cause: src/static/app-backup.js:3135-3148 (loadAtRestState) builds its lines at render time with ooLabelHtml(t('Corpus'), …). That yields one text node, 'Corpus: ' or 'المجموعة: ', which is not a locale key. The i18n walker (src/static/i18n.js doText) caches a node's first-seen text as 'the English', so a label painted in Arabic can never revert. Nothing re-runs the render on a switch: the app-boot.js:41 oo:langchange listener has no entry for the at-rest panel. The bold values translate only because each is a bare key text node.

Call it from app-boot.js's single oo:langchange listener when #atrest-state has been painted. Mark #atrest-state data-i18n-dyn so the walker never caches a translated label as the English.

items.ref: new:First-run guide topic chips: one tag is machine-translated by the i18n walker ('technology' → 'technologie'/'تقنية') while the others stay English, and the counts are ungrouped
items.evidence: Fresh installs in ar (9080) and fr (9180): after the Wikipedia wizard's 'Not now', the guide opened on 'Choose what to collect first'. The 16 #gw-themes chips read 'via:curated 4916, news 3114, general-news 1366, … analysis 225, technologie 209 (fr) / تقنية 209 (ar), healthcare 195, financial 160, business 160'. technology is the only tag translated: its data-theme is 'technology' and fr.json maps 'technology' to 'technologie'. No count is grouped ('4916', '3114', '1366'), whereas the Home strip uses fmtNum ('2 239', '6 411'). Evidence: walk_b_ar.json and walk_b_fr.json (themes, themes_translated). Shots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/U-recheck/shots/B11-guide-themes-ar.png, B11-guide-themes-fr.png.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-core.js:795 renders each tag as a plain `${esc(tg)}` with no data-i18n-dyn. The DOM walker therefore translates any tag that happens to equal a chrome key ('technology'). The same line prints `${byTotal[tg] || 0}` raw instead of fmtNum.
items.suggested_fix: Mark the tag span data-i18n-dyn (or the #gw-themes container) so source tags render verbatim as data, as watch names do since N6. Alternatively, label all tags consistently through a tag→label map. Format the count with fmtNum(byTotal[tg] || 0, 0).

recheck.summary:
I re-checked all 11 walker items on my own fresh instances of build 0deff9c4 and confirmed all 11 (one P2, ten P3).

Setup:
- **Seeded corpus:** a new encrypted STATE C seed at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/U-recheck/seeded. The file header is ciphertext. It booted locked on port 8980 and I unlocked it only through #pw/#btn-unlock; it then read unlocked-encrypted.
- **Fresh installs:** two empty folders (empty_ar on 9080, empty_fr on 9180), each booted as 'fresh'.
- No data folder was copied.
- Scripts, JSON and screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/U-recheck (walk_a.py, walk_b.py, walk_c.py, shots/).

Airplane mode stayed on throughout (plane fill currentColor, /api/system/network online:false), and the browser made no external requests. The only HTTP errors were two 404s from diagnostic URLs my own script probed. I stopped all three servers by PID, and the tree's git status stayed clean.

- **P2, confirmed:** on an idle app the Home strip says '(server busy)'.
  - As of stayed fixed at 10:30:19 while cache_age_s climbed from 13 to 113. The scheduler was not running and no jobs existed.
  - Cause: the client shows the busy note whenever cache_age_s ≥ 90 (app-home.js:117-120). served_cache deliberately never rebuilds an unchanged value and exposes only its build age (served_cache.py:152, :236-244).
- **P3, confirmed:**
  - The At-rest panel does not repaint on a language switch (app-backup.js:3135-3148, and the app-boot.js:41 language-change listener has no entry for it).
  - The calendar directory status, Kind menu and row labels stay English (app-agenda.js:701, :774, :798). I reproduced the exact ar→en case.
  - The data-location path is reordered in Arabic: it is drawn as 'tmp/…/empty_ar/' (unlock.html:135 has no dir="ltr").
  - The wizard host list in Arabic detaches '*.' from 'wikipedia.org' (index.html:3469).
  - The price chart in Arabic puts its axis values over the first bar, and its aria-label keeps English words (app-analysis.js:561-562: the svg inherits rtl, so text-anchor "end" flips).
  - The Patterns-lens panel hard-codes ': ' after its labels (app-diagnostics.js:382, :387-388). This is only wrong in fr, zh and ja; the other locales' label frames use ': ' anyway, so the walker's "all 12 languages" overstates it.
  - The Home 'By channel' chips show raw source_type codes (app-home.js:679).
  - The Law table shows 'reader' and 'official ↗' in English in every locale (app-gov-law.js:1011-1012). The '(N flagged)' part is confirmed from code only (:1010), because the seed has no flagged revision.
  - French Home status reads 'arrêté' instead of 'arrêtée' (the shared 'stopped' key, app-home.js:234 and fr.json:757).
  - In the first-run guide, the i18n walker translates only the 'technology' tag, and no count is grouped (app-core.js:795).
